info.title: Prisme private infrastructure API (provisional name)
info.description: TLS 1.3 private API with application sessions, passkeys and an explicit local development mode. Standard JSON request bodies are limited to 16 KiB; the GitHub-only webhook accepts up to 2 MiB and authenticates exact raw bytes using HMAC SHA-256. Provider resources are read-only and bounded. Admission per minute: 120 per unauthenticated transport address, 1200 per verified session, 180 per verified agent; 6000 aggregate, 32 active requests and 8 terminal streams. Proxy headers are never identities. Health probes are separate. Phase 6 operations accept bounded 2 MiB JSON, require exact one-use passkey/Android proofs, and expose native WebSocket PTYs; see contracts/operations-v1.md. Recovery authentication is a separate authority. Phase 7 adds durable Restic backup jobs and isolated restore plans; see contracts/backup-v1.md. Phase 9 adds bounded remediation and versioned runbooks; see contracts/automation-v1.md. Automation starts globally stopped. Phase 10 adds guided project onboarding and reviewed generated files; production qualification remains separate.

post.description: GitHub-only endpoint. HMAC SHA-256 over exact raw bytes, scoped installation/repository and durable delivery deduplication; maximum 2 MiB. Does not accept application sessions as webhook authentication.
Creates an immutable 15-minute plan without runtime mutations. Idempotency keys bind the complete request. Only imported immutable releases matching the target are eligible.

Approval requires exact target phrase, current revision, unchanged baseline, no blockers and no other active job. Cancellation is allowed before execution only. Repeated identical decisions are idempotent. Production approval remains blocked until platform step-up is available.

post.description: No automatic retry. Proof binds action, destination, revision and complete payload. See operations-v1.md for per-action requirements.

get.description: Native WSS with bearer and one-use X-Prisme-Terminal-Ticket headers. No tokens in URL. Stream protocol in operations-v1.md.

post.description: Registers a project in an operator-provisioned hosting target and prepares its first deployment. Requires a recent session and an allowed GitHub mapping. No execution or Git writes. Retry a lost response using the same key. All deployment approvals and production step-up checks still apply.

device_id.description: Stable installation ID. Omit only for phase-zero compatibility.

inventory.description: InventorySnapshot object, or null before first observation. Source and observed_at determine freshness independently of heartbeat.

proof.description: Single-use proof bound to this session, job and revision. Required for production approval.

OperationsResult.description: Discriminated by the requested action; bounded result fields are documented in operations-v1.md. Values are never cacheable.
